rounds.literal: Indoda ibambe inkunzi enkulu ngeempondo, abantu ecaleni betsiba besoyika.
rounds.story: Kusetyenziswa xa umntu engaphephi ubunzima, esiya ngqo kwingxaki ukuze ayisombulule.

rounds.literal: Umfazi uzama ukuhlaba ikhwelo ngentonga, lona lisenza ingxolo lihamba emoyeni.
rounds.story: Le ntetho isetyenziswa xa kubizwa abantu, uncedo okanye ingqalelo ngokukhawuleza ngenxa yengxaki okanye iindaba ezibalulekileyo.

rounds.literal: Indoda iluma indlebe yomhlobo wayo kancinci, ngathi ifaka imfihlo ngaphakathi.
rounds.story: Kuthiwa xa umntu ekulumkisa okanye ekuxelela into ebalulekileyo ngokufihlakeleyo ukuze bangavi abanye.

rounds.literal: Umntu uluma ulwimi lwakhe, amehlo emakhulu, ukuze kungaphumi lizwi.
rounds.story: Isetyenziswa xa umntu ezibamba angathethi, mhlawumbi ukuze angonakalisi izinto okanye angangeni engxakini.

rounds.literal: Umama uvula imbiza evaliweyo, kuphume amagama neemfihlo ngathi ngumsi.
rounds.story: Xa kufihlwe imfihlo ibe umntu uyayiveza, kusithiwa utyhile imbiza.

rounds.literal: Kwitafile kukho iliso elikhulu libekwe ecaleni kwekhekhe, lingaqhwanyazi.
rounds.story: Le ntetho ivela xa umntu ejonge ngomonde, ekhathalele okanye elinda into ingaphumi emehlweni.

rounds.literal: Indoda ihlamba izandla ixesha elide, kanti ingxaki ihleli ecaleni ijongile.
rounds.story: Kusetyenziswa xa umntu esithi akasenanto yakwenza nengxaki okanye umsebenzi, ezisusa kuxanduva.

rounds.literal: Umntu ubeka izitya, iincwadi nezihlangu elangeni ukuze wonke umntu azibone.
rounds.story: Xa umntu echaza into kakuhle, engenafihlo nangokucacileyo, kuthiwa ubeke izinto elubala.

rounds.literal: Umoya onjengebhaluni uwela phantsi xa umntu ewutyhala ngesandla.
rounds.story: Le ntetho isetyenziswa xa amazwi okanye izenzo zomntu zenza abanye baphelelwe lithemba.

rounds.literal: Umfazi uthwele ilitye elinzima emqolo, enyuka induli kancinci.
rounds.story: Kuthiwa xa umntu ephila okanye esebenza nzima kakhulu, enobunzima obuninzi.

kids.literal: Izandla ezimbini zihlambana ebhaketheni, ngathi nganye inceda enye icoceke.
kids.story: Oku kuthetha ukuba abantu mabancedane. Umsebenzi uba lula xa sisenza kunye.

kids.literal: Umntwana umi phakathi kwabantu abambambileyo ukuze angawi phantsi.
kids.story: Kuthetha ukuba siphila kakuhle nabanye abantu. Umntu akakhuli yedwa.

kids.literal: Iqili lijija intamo lizama ukukhotha emhlana, kodwa alifiki kwaphela.
options: wonke umntu ufuna uncedo ngamanye amaxesha
kids.story: Kuthetha ukuba wonke umntu ufuna uncedo ngamanye amaxesha, nokuba uqaqambe kangakanani.

kids.literal: Intaka incothula uboya benja, yakhe indlwane ethambileyo emthini.
options: ukusebenzisa into evela komnye ukwenza okwakho
kids.story: Kuthetha ukusebenzisa into evela komnye ukuze wenze okwakho. Abantu bahlala bencedisana kanje.

kids.literal: Inja ijika ibuyele emhlanzweni wayo, impumlo isebenza ngathi ifumene ubuncwane.
kids.story: Kusetyenziswa xa umntu eshiya umkhwa ombi, aze abuye kwakhona kuwo.

kids.literal: Umfana uzama ukuvala umlomo ngesandla, kodwa amagama asafuna ukuphuma.
kids.story: Kuthethwa xa umntu kufuneka ayeke ukuthetha, mhlawumbi athule kancinci.

kids.literal: Intombazana ivula amehlo ngathi ngamafestile, ukukhanya kungena ngaphakathi.
kids.story: Kuthetha ukuqonda into obungayazi ngaphambili. Ngathi ngoku uyayibona kakuhle.

kids.literal: Umntwana uphuma phantsi kwesingubo, ame ngeenyawo zakhe omelele.
kids.story: Le ntetho isetyenziswa xa umntu ephinde omelele emva kobunzima.

kids.literal: Iinyawo zishiya amanqaku amakhulu eludakeni, wonke umntu ewalandela.
kids.story: Kuthetha ukwenza into eza kukhunjulwa ngabanye abantu ixesha elide.

kids.literal: Abantwana baphosa ilitye elinye kwinqwaba, ide ikhule ibe phezulu.
kids.story: Kuthetha ukongeza into yakho emsebenzini wabanye. Nencinci iyanceda.
